name: AutoRF
aliases: Learning 3D Object Radiance Fields from Single View Observations
definition: A method for learning 3D object radiance fields from a single view observation without prior geometry knowledge (e.g., CAD models). It disentangles object representation into shape and appearance components using a normalized, object-centric encoding conditioned on 3D bounding boxes and 2D masks.
summary: AutoRF learns 3D radiance fields from single views by disentangling shape and appearance using bounding boxes and masks, unlike multi-view methods.
